transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well, student health actually sent me here. I'm trying to get cleared to help out with these youth workshops, but they told me my weight is too low to sign off on it. They said the number on the scale has just kept dropping. I mean, I guess it has, but to me it just feels like... what happens when I’m focused and really busy with my classes, you know?
Are you afraid of gaining weight or becoming heavier?

Yes. Honestly, even the idea of gaining a single pound makes me panic. It's just... if I were to sit down and eat a normal dinner, or have something with butter in it, I feel like everyone would immediately be able to see that I’ve lost my discipline. So, yes, the thought of getting heavier really scares me.
Have you had episodes where you felt unable to control yourself while eating an unusually large amount of food?

No, not at all. I don't really... I don't ever eat large amounts of food. It's kind of the opposite for me. I keep very strict control over everything I eat, so I've never had a time where I felt out of control like that.
Have you used any way to purge or compensate after eating, such as making yourself vomit or misusing laxatives, diuretics, or enemas?

No, I haven't done anything like that. I don't make myself throw up or use laxatives or anything. Like I said, I just... I control what I eat in the first place, so I don't need to do any of those things.
